verdict.rationale: Svelte's compiler emits lean JavaScript that surgically updates the DOM, and it offers scoped CSS, shareable reactive logic in .svelte.js/.ts modules, and `sv check` for static checking, all of which support performance and maintainability. One hands-on report describes migrating a huge, complex React app with large gains in performance, bundle size and productivity. Against that, community reports mention rendering-heavy UIs hitting limits (Svelte 4), IDE-support friction, and a thin component ecosystem. Missing for 10: first-party guidance on structuring large codebases and team-scale workflows, explicit evidence of performance at scale, and mature testing/IDE tooling evidence.
